data.text/markdown:
Take-Home Pay Calculator

1. The Question

Who would use this, and what decision does it help them make? For people that will be taking a job in a different state and trying to find out their income after state taxes. This tool should help them plan and budget as needed together with the financial planning tool created for mp1.

2. My Plan Before AI

Fetching state tax rates, federal tax rates, social security, and medicare is a must. Then fetching the paycheck. We then apply social security and medicare withholdings, subtract the pretax deductibles from the gross salary, then apply the federal and state tax brackets, , and finally subtract any post-tax deductions to arrive at the net take-home pay. To complete yourself: the assignment also requests at least five lines of steps, function inputs and outputs, API addresses, record completeness, and two numbers to check. Keep your original plan and describe later additions honestly.

3. Inputs

Money inputs are annual dollars except the 401(k) percentage. These are fictional examples, not personal financial information. This version covers a full year working and living in Virginia, one wage earner under 50, standard deductions, no dependents or special credits. Filing status can be single, married (joint), or head (head of household). Health insurance and HSA contributions must be eligible pretax payroll deductions. A move during the year can require a separate part-year state calculation.

4. The Work

Source: PaySums API. The tables contain one federal record and all supplied state records; there is no pagination. The selected state record supplies the code used in the paycheck request.

7. Working With the Agent

The calculation for this table is overall simple, both here and the API has returned with the same endpoint. I did add the pre-tax deductible, in cell 2, back into the calculation.

8. Reading It Back

One very important one is having the fetch_tax_tables, we put in the API base address and requested year, it comes out with a list of federal and state tax records. This just tells you how the taxes are calculated, rather than calculating the taxes. The other one is calculate_bracket_tax, we put in the taxable income and the list of tax brackets. This is where the calculation comes out, and it applies how much marginal taxis owed at each bracket level, summing up the total tax owed based on the taxable income provided.

9. Going Further
